text: That swamp you'll fly over in GTA 6?
It's based on the Everglades, and the real one once swallowed a passenger jet.
ValuJet Flight 592 takes off from Miami, heading for Atlanta with 110 people on board.
Minutes later, the crew reports smoke.
The plane dives into the Everglades at high speed.
Rescuers arrive to find almost nothing.
Just jet fuel floating on the water between the sawgrass.
The plane had disappeared into the mud.
Investigators later traced the fire to oxygen generators that should never have been loaded into the cargo hold.
Follow for more of the real places behind GTA 6.
